metadata.title: Retro Soul Portrait with Airbrushed Sky

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, soft-focus portrait of a woman with voluminous 1970s hair and a white scarf, set against a hazy, airbrushed blue and white sky. The composition is framed by stylized, diagonal graphic elements in the upper corners featuring rainbow stripes and energetic script lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a soft, atmospheric background
Diagonal graphic elements mirroring each other in upper corners
Contrast between the organic portrait and the geometric rainbow stripes
Soft, warm skin tones against a cool, hazy blue environment
coreInvariants: Airbrushed cloud texture in the background
White fabric element draped around the neck

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-length portrait, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the voluminous hair shape.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, moves outward to the diagonal graphic elements in the corners, then follows the white scarf downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Hazy blue sky filling the upper and side margins, providing breathing room for the graphics.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and white (background and scarf)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and warm skin tones (subject)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, hazy saturation in the background with high-contrast, saturated accents in the corner graphics.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to 1970s earth tones and primary rainbow hues

letterConstructionRules: Thick, brush-like strokes with tapered ends
Letters integrated with horizontal/diagonal speed lines
Heavy white outline around the script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated to follow the diagonal flow of the background stripes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the expressive script with a very small, widely-spaced sans-serif for secondary metadata at the top edge.

avoid: Modern geometric sans-serifs as primary focus

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the airbrushed commercial art aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus portrait of a woman with 70s disco hair and a white scarf, centered against a hazy, airbrushed blue and white sky background. Leave the upper corners clear for graphic overlays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two diagonal graphic clusters in the upper corners. Each cluster consists of a 4-color rainbow stripe (red, orange, yellow, white) at a 45-degree angle, with custom bold script lettering outlined in white placed on top.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture sufficiently hazy/airbrushed?
Do the corner graphics mirror each other's angle?
Is the script lettering slanted to match the diagonal stripes?
Is the white scarf the brightest point of the central figure?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original titles

mustAchieve: Soft, diffused lighting on the face
Clean, sharp vector graphics for the corners
Seamless blending of the airbrushed sky
avoid: Hard digital edges in the background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script has a thick white border to separate it from the stripes.
Check that the sky has a grainy, analog airbrush texture.
Verify the subject's hair has a soft, halo-like silhouette.
Confirm the diagonal stripes are perfectly parallel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered soft-focus portrait, place it against an airbrushed atmospheric background, and frame the top with mirrored diagonal rainbow-and-script graphic elements.
